    <script>
    function tsLoadServerBtn(btn) {
        var value = btn.getAttribute('data-value');
        if (!value) return;

        document.querySelectorAll('.ts-server-btn').forEach(function(b) {
            b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn);
        });

        var sel = document.querySelector('select.mirror');
        if (sel) {
            for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
                if (sel.options[i].value === value) { sel.selectedIndex = i; break; }
            }
        }

        if (typeof loadMi === 'function') loadMi({ value: value });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        var sel = document.querySelector('select.mirror');
        if (sel) {
            sel.addEventListener('change', function () {
                var value = this.value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.ts-server-btn').forEach(function(b) {
                    b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-value') === value);
                });
            });
        }

        if (!sel) return;

        var episodeNum = (document.querySelector('.entry-title') || {}).textContent || '';
        var epMatch = episodeNum.match(/Episode\s+(\d+)/i);
        var epNum = epMatch ? epMatch[1] : '';

        var opts = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < sel.options.length; i++) {
            if (sel.options[i].value) {
                opts.push({ label: sel.options[i].text, value: sel.options[i].value, selected: sel.options[i].selected });
            }
        }
        if (opts.length === 0) return;

		var groups = { SUB: [], RAW: [], DUB: [] };
        opts.forEach(function(o) {
    	var upper = o.label.toUpperCase();
    		if (upper.indexOf('RAW') !== -1) {
      	  groups.RAW.push(o);
   			 } else if (upper.indexOf('DUB') !== -1) {
     	  groups.DUB.push(o);
    			} else {
        groups.SUB.push(o);
    }
});
var anySelected = groups.SUB.concat(groups.RAW).concat(groups.DUB).some(function(o) { return o.selected; });
if (!anySelected && opts.length > 0) opts[0].selected = true;

        function makeRow(type, items) {
			var labelHTML = type === 'RAW'
    			? '<span class="ts-server-label"><span class="ts-cc-icon ts-raw-icon">R</span> RAW:</span>'
    			: type === 'DUB'
    			? '<span class="ts-server-label"><span class="ts-cc-icon ts-dub-icon">D</span> Dub:</span>'
    			: '<span class="ts-server-label"><span class="ts-cc-icon">CC</span> Sub:</span>';

            var btns = items.map(function(o) {
			var match = o.label.match(/^(SUB|RAW|DUB)\s*(v\d+)?\s*[-–]\s*(.+)$/i);				
			var shortLabel = match ? (match[3] + (match[2] ? ' ' + match[2] : '')) : o.label;
                return '<button type="button" class="ts-server-btn' + (o.selected ? ' active' : '') + '" ' +
                    'data-value="' + o.value.replace(/"/g, '&quot;') + '" ' +
                    'onclick="tsLoadServerBtn(this)">' + shortLabel + '</button>';
            }).join('');

            return '<div class="ts-server-right">' +
                labelHTML +
                '<div class="ts-server-btns">' + btns + '</div>' +
                '</div>';
        }

        var rowsHTML = '';
        if (groups.SUB.length > 0) rowsHTML += makeRow('SUB', groups.SUB);
        if (groups.DUB.length > 0) rowsHTML += makeRow('DUB', groups.DUB);
		if (groups.RAW.length > 0) rowsHTML += makeRow('RAW', groups.RAW);

        var block = document.createElement('div');
        block.className = 'ts-server-block';
        block.innerHTML =
            '<div class="ts-server-notice">' +
                '<p>You are watching <strong>Episode ' + epNum + '</strong>. If current server doesn\'t work please try other servers beside.</p>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="ts-server-rows">' + rowsHTML + '</div>';

        var videoNav = document.querySelector('.item.video-nav');
        if (videoNav && videoNav.parentNode) {
            videoNav.parentNode.insertBefore(block, videoNav.nextSibling);
        }
    });
    </script>

	}

jQuery("#thememode input[type='checkbox']").on('change', function(){
	var is_on = jQuery("#thememode input[type='checkbox']").prop("checked");
	if (is_on == false){
		if (dmlogo2) jQuery(".logos img").attr('src', dmlogo2);
		localStorage.setItem("thememode", "lightmode");
		jQuery("body").addClass("lightmode");

		localStorage.setItem("thememode", "darkmode");
		jQuery("body").removeClass("lightmode");
		jQuery("body").addClass("darkmode");
	}
});
